frame.label: Frame / structure
frame.reason: Frames are usually bent tube joined by welds. Bending removes joints, and welding closes the structure.

cart.label: Cart
cart.reason: Carts are among the medical solutions Right lists: a bent tube frame, formed sheet shelves and installed hardware.

handle-rail.label: Handle / rail
handle-rail.reason: Handles and rails are classic mandrel-bent tube. A die library matched to the tube size keeps bends clean and repeatable.

bracket.label: Bracket / tab / mount
bracket.reason: Brackets and tabs are typically punched flat, then formed on a CNC press brake.

enclosure.label: Enclosure / housing
enclosure.reason: Enclosures are punched flat patterns formed on press brakes, often spot welded, with hardware installed and a coated finish.

panel.label: Panel
panel.reason: Panels, doors and shelves are sheared, punched and formed from flat sheet.

display.label: Monitor / display component
display.reason: Monitor display components are among the medical solutions Right lists: formed sheet and tube with hardware and finish.

rack.label: Rack / cage
rack.reason: Racks and cages are bent tube structures, usually welded and powder coated for outdoor use.

channel.label: Formed channel
channel.reason: Right lists 3D bending of channels alongside tube.

extrusion.label: Extrusion
extrusion.reason: Right processes custom extruded shapes: cut to length, machined on HAAS mills and bent where needed.

assembly-unit.label: Multi-part assembly
assembly-unit.reason: Multi-part products need hardware, assembly and packaging as well as the fabricated parts.

prototype.label: Prototype
prototype.detail: Prototypes validate design before production, and get the same attention to precision as large orders.

rush.label: Rush
rush.detail: 48-hour turnaround on select prototypes and rush orders.

low-volume.label: Low volume / high mix
low-volume.detail: High-mix, lower-volume programs are core to Right's industrial work.

production.label: Production
production.detail: Scalable production: 10,000+ precision parts manufactured annually.

rules.tube-bend: Bent tube → mandrel bending on 2 pull-type benders with 100+ dies.
rules.tube-compound: Multi-plane bends → 3D bending with plane-of-bend control.
rules.tube-holes: Holes and slots in tube → tube punching.
rules.sheet-holes: Features in flat sheet → CNC turret punching.
rules.sheet-default: Sheet parts are usually punched flat and formed on a press brake.
rules.tube-default: Tube work starts with cut-off, then bending.
rules.weld-stainless: Welded stainless → TIG, which gives fine control for clean, visible welds.
rules.weld-aluminum: Welded aluminum → TIG for control, MIG where speed matters.
rules.weld-carbon: Welded carbon steel → MIG for strong, efficient structural welds.
rules.weld-generic: Welded assembly → MIG or TIG depending on material and appearance.
rules.sheet-lap-weld: Sheet-to-sheet joints can be spot welded without filler.
rules.welded-tabs: Tabs and brackets on a tube frame → formed on the press brake, then welded on.
rules.mounting: Mounting points usually need installed hardware, fitted and alignment-checked before delivery.
rules.medical-finish: Medical equipment calls for environmentally clean exterior coating.
rules.outdoor: Outdoor or corrosive environments → durable powder coat or Cerakote through APC.
rules.proto: Prototype → built with production-level precision. 48-hour turnaround on select prototypes and rush orders.
rules.production: Production → repeatable runs, 10,000+ precision parts a year.
rules.proto-to-prod: Prototype to production under one supplier.
rules.unsure: Not sure of the process → engineers with 30+ years' experience help with design.
rules.tapped: Machined features → HAAS CNC vertical mills.

specialty-metals.message: Right's materials page mentions titanium and specialty metals, but its core list is aluminum, stainless and carbon steel. Confirm with engineering.

copper-brass.message: Copper and brass appear in Right's materials imagery but not in its published material list. Confirm with engineering.

laser-cutting.message: Right's published equipment list covers shearing and CNC turret punching; laser cutting isn't listed. Confirm with engineering.

other-welding.message: Right's published welding capabilities are MIG, TIG and spot welding. Confirm other processes with the team.

other-finishes.message: Published finishing through APC is powder coating, Cerakote, blasting, masking, wash and laser marking. Confirm other finishes with the team.

tolerances.message: Right doesn't publish general tolerances. They depend on geometry, material and process and are confirmed on drawing review.

certifications.message: Certifications and registrations aren't published on rightmfg.com. Ask the team for current quality documentation.

casting-forging.message: Casting and forging aren't among Right's published capabilities.

plastics.message: Right is a metal fabricator. Plastic and molded parts aren't among its published capabilities.

additive.message: Additive manufacturing isn't among Right's published capabilities.

turning-5axis.message: Right's published machining is CNC vertical milling (3 HAAS mills). Turning and 5-axis aren't listed.

other-cutting.message: Waterjet, plasma and EDM aren't among Right's published cutting processes.

other-forming.message: This forming process isn't among Right's published capabilities. Right forms with press brakes, punch presses and mandrel/3D bending.

electronics.message: Electronics and wiring aren't among Right's published capabilities. Right can deliver the metal structure and mechanical assembly.

non-metals.message: Right fabricates metal. Non-metal materials aren't among its published capabilities.

servicesNeeded.title: Recommended manufacturing route
servicesNeeded.body: Based on what you've described, this is the route Right would typically use: each process in sequence, with the reason it applies. An engineer confirms the final route when they review your drawing.
servicesNeeded.titleEmpty: Describe the part and I'll map the route
servicesNeeded.bodyEmpty: Tell me what you're making, the material, and roughly how many. For example: 'aluminum tube frame with welded tabs, 200 units'. I'll map it to Right's forming, welding, secondary and finishing processes.

prototypes.title: Yes. Prototype through production.
prototypes.body: Right develops prototypes to validate designs and test function before production, with the same attention to precision as large orders. That lets you fine-tune the spec and reduce risk before committing to volume.
bullets: 48-hour turnaround on select prototypes and rush orders
Engineers with 30+ years of experience help refine the design
The same equipment and team carry the part into production

squareTube.title: Yes. Round and square tube.
squareTube.body: Right's two pull-type mandrel benders run a library of more than 100 bending dies covering a wide variety of round and square tubes. Plane-of-bend control and pressure die assist help hold geometry through the bend.

materials.title: Aluminum, stainless and carbon steel
materials.body: Right fabricates in {materials}, in sheet and tube, and keeps a consistent material inventory for fast turnaround. Material is chosen for strength, formability and the application.

materialChoice.title: Match the metal to the job
materialChoice.body: Steel is usually stronger, but aluminum is lighter and resists corrosion well. Right recommends aluminum where weight matters and steel for heavy-duty strength. Stainless is the choice when strength and corrosion resistance both matter. The team looks at strength, corrosion resistance, weight and weldability for your application.

welding.title: Yes. MIG, TIG and spot welding.
welding.body: Right welds steel, stainless steel and aluminum alloys. Experienced technicians use calibrated equipment and process controls, and welds are inspected for strength and finish.
bullets: MIG: quick, strong welds for structural work
TIG: detailed control for visible or thin work

bending.title: Yes. Tube, channel and sheet.
bending.body: Tube and channel are bent on two pull-type mandrel benders with 100+ dies, including 3D multi-plane bends with plane-of-bend control. Sheet is formed on four Cincinnati CNC press brakes (60, 90 and 135 ton).

finishing.title: Yes, through sister company APC.
finishing.body: Finishing is handled by {apc}, Right's partner for {years} years, also located in the heart of San Diego's industrial complex. An automatic conveyor line handles high-volume parts, and batch application covers larger units and smaller volumes.

machining.title: Yes. CNC vertical milling.
machining.body: Right runs three HAAS CNC vertical mills for machined features on formed and fabricated parts: drilled, tapped and milled features on sheet, tube and extrusions.

assembly.title: Yes. Delivered complete.
assembly.body: Right handles hardware installation, component integration, fastener fitting, mid- and high-level assembly, packaging and logistics. Hardware compatibility and alignment are double-checked before delivery.

equipment.title: Equipment on Right's floor
equipment.body: The published equipment list, from Right's capability pages and brochure:

leadTime.title: 48 hours on select prototypes and rush orders
leadTime.body: Lead times depend on complexity, material availability, finish and quantity. Simple tube jobs can be same-day or next-day in some cases. Right keeps a consistent material inventory and confirms a timeline once specs are reviewed.

volume.title: From one prototype to production volume
volume.body: Right supports high-mix, lower-volume programs through higher-volume production and manufactures more than 10,000 precision parts a year. Prototypes and production runs use the same team and equipment.

tolerance.title: Confirmed on drawing review
tolerance.body: Right doesn't publish general tolerances, because achievable tolerance depends on geometry, material and process. Send your drawing and the engineering team will confirm what they can hold on your features.

certifications.title: Ask the team for quality documentation
certifications.body: Certifications and registrations aren't published on rightmfg.com, so this tool won't guess. Right's team can tell you exactly what quality documentation your program needs.

industries.title: Industries Right serves
industries.body: Right focuses on OEM customers across these markets from its 20,000 sq. ft. San Diego facility:

location.title: San Diego, California
location.body: A 20,000 sq. ft. facility at {address}, in the heart of San Diego's industrial complex. Finishing partner APC is also based there.

about.title: 25+ years. 35 people. 20+ years average experience.
about.body: Right was founded in the 1990s in San Diego's industrial core with a service-first mission. Today it's a 35-person company whose team averages more than 20 years of experience, led by General Manager Greg Lyon, Customer Service Manager Karra Lyon and Production Manager LH Byrd. 98% of clients stay.

quote.title: Start with a drawing
quote.body: Share technical drawings or a description and your requirements. Right's team reviews your specifications and returns a detailed quote and timeline.

contact.title: Talk to manufacturing
contact.body: Call {phone} or email {email}. Or start a project online and attach your drawings.

greeting.title: Describe what you need to manufacture
greeting.body: Tell me about the part: what it is, the material, the features (bends, welds, holes, hardware, finish) and roughly how many. I'll match it to Right's verified capabilities and explain why each one applies.

ui.clarify: I couldn't match that to a specific process yet. Describe the part, the material, and features like bends, welds, holes, hardware or finish.
